messages:
Jordan (NeonBox): Hey team — we got internal sign-off on the renewal but procurement says they need the PO + a different signer than originally listed. can we do a stop-gap so seats don't lapse?
Sam Patel: Thanks Jordan. what's the exact signer name they want? and is the PO ready?
Jordan (NeonBox): They want the invoice signed by 'NeonBox Corp — AP Team' (not the product owner). PO will be generated but won't be ready until next week. renewal date is 4/3 so we're tight.
Priya Rao: @SamPatel we need the legal signer on the amendment to match billing entity. if they're switching to AP Team we need delegated signing authority doc or an emailed approval chain. otherwise legal won't countersign.
Sam Patel: Got it. @PriyaRao can we accept an interim commercial invoice to prevent service interruption and then attach the final PO afterwards? finance usually accepts a provisional invoice with a follow-up PO.
Luca Moretti: Finance here — provisional invoice works but we need a clear reference to the eventual PO and a small TODO in notes. also need a billing contact and the AP email for routing.
Jordan (NeonBox): AP email is ap@neonbox.com. we can get the PO by 4/8.
Priya Rao: OK. propose this flow: 1) CS issues provisional invoice with NeonBox billing entity and AP email, signed by account team. 2) Customer pays via CC or wires if they can. 3) Once PO arrives, we attach and file, and issue the formal amendment for legal sign-off (no service rollback).
Sam Patel: Sounds good. I can generate the provisional invoice now. Luca, can you confirm finance will accept remittance and reconcile later when PO is attached?
Luca Moretti: Yes — condition: invoice must include this block in the notes (copy/paste):
```
Pending final Purchase Order. PO will be attached by 2026-04-08. Reference: NEON-RENEW-0426.
Billing contact: ap@neonbox.com
```
Luca Moretti: Also need invoice lines for seat counts and a subtotal.
Sam Patel: I'm drafting invoice. quick check on pricing — renewal includes the promo credit we agreed in the last call (-10% on seats for year 1). Jordan confirm?
Jordan (NeonBox): yes that's right — apply the credit.
Sam Patel: Draft invoice (putting sample PO ref for later):
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0426
Customer: NeonBox Corp (billing entity)
Seats: 75 x $15/mo (annual prepay)
Promo credit: -10% on seat subtotal
Total due: $121,500
Notes: Pending final Purchase Order (see reference).
```
Sam Patel: @LucaMoretti is this sufficient for a provisional charge?
Luca Moretti: Yes. I'll mark finance flagged-accept. They can process CC/wire. If they wire, provide wiring instructions in the invoice.
Priya Rao: After payment, legal will still need the amendment signed by the legal signee. Jordan — can AP provide a short email from their legal or procurement confirming delegated signer? a one-line approval should be fine.
Jordan (NeonBox): I can get an approval email from procurement. will ask for a cc to legal.
Sam Patel: I'll send the invoice to ap@neonbox.com and also to procurement@neonbox.com. sending via DocuSign for signature on our side so there's a clear trail.
DocuSign Bot: DocuSign envelope 0A9F sent to Jordan (NeonBox) and Sam Patel for signature. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/0A9F
Jordan (NeonBox): Received the envelope, signing now.
Sam Patel: Thanks — once signed and payment initiated we consider the renewal executed operationally. legal will follow up for the amendment paperwork.
Priya Rao: I'll prepare the amendment template and keep it staged. once the PO and approval email arrive I'll slot in the final signer and countersign.
Luca Moretti: One operational note: when PO attached, include PO number in our billing system as `PO_REF`. we reconcile monthly.
Sam Patel: Copy — action items: (1) Sam send provisional invoice today; (2) Jordan get approval email from procurement; (3) NeonBox to initiate payment; (4) Priya stage amendment for final signature. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:
Jordan (NeonBox): On it, thanks everyone. will update when AP confirms.
